notes: Overlay sources are independent MapLibre sources/layers. They are not merged into the active PMTiles basemap.

overlays.name: USGS Topo
overlays.description: Online USGS National Map topographic raster overlay. Offline topo will later use vector contours/hillshade or selective caching.

overlays.name: Satellite Imagery
overlays.description: Online satellite imagery raster overlay for visual reference. Requires internet and is not cached for offline use yet.

overlays.name: USGS Topographic Contours
overlays.description: Offline vector contour lines generated from USGS 3DEP / The National Map DEM tiles for the configured trip region or bbox.
overlays.warning: Contour lines are generated from USGS elevation rasters for the selected bbox. Build once online, then use fully offline.

overlays.name: MVUM Roads
overlays.description: USFS Motor Vehicle Use Map road overlay. Place or generate PMTiles/GeoJSON under /data/oiab/maps/overlays/mvum and rescan.

overlays.name: MVUM Trails
overlays.description: USFS Motor Vehicle Use Map trail overlay. Place or generate PMTiles/GeoJSON under /data/oiab/maps/overlays/mvum and rescan.

overlays.name: BLM Land Boundaries
overlays.description: Cached Bureau of Land Management vector surface management agency areas from the national SMA polygon dataset. Refresh downloads the detailed national source for offline use; bbox-limited trip extracts are supported by the refresh job.
overlays.attribution: Bureau of Land Management Surface Management Agency
overlays.warning: BLM SMA shows surface management agency areas, not legal parcel ownership boundaries.

overlays.name: BLM Wilderness / WSA
overlays.description: Cached BLM National Landscape Conservation System wilderness and wilderness study area polygons from the official national service. Refresh downloads the generalized national source for offline use; bbox-limited extracts are supported by the refresh job.
overlays.attribution: Bureau of Land Management NLCS Wilderness / WSA
overlays.warning: BLM Wilderness / WSA uses the official national generalized NLCS service; it is suitable for trip planning and orientation, not parcel-precision boundary interpretation.

overlays.name: PAD-US Protected Lands
overlays.description: Offline vector protected/public land overlay generated from the USGS PAD-US dataset. Supports national, state, or bbox-limited packs.
overlays.source_instructions: OIAB defaults to the USGS PAD-US 4.1 Vector Analysis PADUS-only package from ScienceBase, which is a better map overlay than the full inventory because overlaps are resolved for display. Paste a different national/state/bbox package URL only if you want to override the default. OIAB will convert it with GDAL/tippecanoe.

provider_fields.label: PAD-US source URL
provider_fields.help: Optional. Leave blank to use the built-in USGS PAD-US 4.1 Vector Analysis PADUS-only ScienceBase package. Custom URLs may be GeoPackage, FileGDB zip, shapefile zip, or GeoJSON.

overlays.warning: PAD-US is a protected-area inventory. It is not a parcel ownership or legal access boundary layer.

overlays.name: NHD Water Features
overlays.description: Offline vector water overlay generated from USGS National Hydrography Dataset flowlines and waterbodies for the selected travel region.
overlays.source_instructions: NHD is distributed by USGS as regional products such as GeoPackage, FileGDB, and shapefile packages. Choose the region you want from The National Map/NHD download tools, paste the direct package URL, and OIAB will convert it into PMTiles.

provider_fields.label: NHD source URL
provider_fields.help: Paste a direct USGS NHD GeoPackage/FileGDB/shapefile zip URL for the travel region. If the package has several layers, set OIAB_NHD_LAYER in the environment for now.

overlays.name: RIDB Recreation Sites
overlays.description: Cached Recreation Information Database facilities and recreation sites. Refresh by bbox before a trip; cached points remain available offline.
overlays.source_instructions: Create a free RIDB API key from Recreation.gov for bbox refreshes, or paste the official RIDB full JSON ZIP export URL for an offline national cache. OIAB converts the ZIP into a local GeoJSON point overlay.

provider_fields.label: RIDB API key
provider_fields.help: Required for live Recreation.gov/RIDB refreshes.

provider_fields.label: RIDB source URL
provider_fields.help: Optional. Supports the official RIDB full JSON ZIP export or a direct GeoJSON snapshot URL.

overlays.name: Historic Places
overlays.description: Cached National Park Service National Register of Historic Places point and boundary data. Refresh downloads public NRIS/National Register spatial data for offline use.
overlays.source_instructions: OIAB defaults to the National Park Service public National Register of Historic Places ArcGIS service. Leave the source URL blank unless NPS publishes a replacement service.

provider_fields.label: NPS NRHP service URL
provider_fields.help: Optional. Use only if the default NPS service changes.

overlays.attribution: National Park Service, National Register of Historic Places / NRIS public spatial data. Historic place locations and boundaries may be approximate.

overlays.name: OpenCaching
overlays.description: Cached OpenCaching.us geocache points from OKAPI bbox refreshes and local GPX imports. Refresh before a trip; cached points remain available offline.
overlays.source_instructions: Create an OpenCaching OKAPI consumer key, paste it here, then refresh by bbox before a trip. You can also place GPX files under /data/oiab/maps/overlays/opencaching/import and refresh/rescan without a key.

provider_fields.label: OpenCaching OKAPI consumer key
provider_fields.help: Required for live OpenCaching.us OKAPI bbox refreshes. Local GPX imports work without a key.

provider_fields.label: OpenCaching OKAPI base URL
provider_fields.help: Optional. Defaults to OpenCaching.us. Use another OKAPI-compatible site only if desired.

provider_fields.label: Default cache bbox
provider_fields.help: Optional. minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat. If blank, refresh uses the request bbox or the CONUS default.

overlays.name: Campflare Campgrounds
overlays.description: Cached Campflare campground points from the latest provider dump. Refresh downloads the Campflare dump manifest and regenerates all Campflare overlays for offline use.
overlays.source_instructions: Create a Campflare API key from the Campflare Platform and paste it here. OIAB stores no Campflare data in the repo; Download/Update fetches the latest signed dump files and builds local campground, campsite, land POI, public land, and notice overlays. Attribution is required when displayed.

provider_fields.label: Campflare API key
provider_fields.help: Required for Campflare downloads. Generate a key from the Campflare Platform; OIAB sends it as the Authorization header.

overlays.name: Campflare Campsites
overlays.description: Cached individual Campflare campsite points. This can be a large overlay; keep it disabled until zoomed into a trip area if browser performance matters.

provider_fields.label: Campflare API key
provider_fields.help: Required for Campflare downloads.

overlays.name: Campflare Land POIs
overlays.description: Cached Campflare land-related points of interest such as campground and destination POIs where available.

provider_fields.label: Campflare API key
provider_fields.help: Required for Campflare downloads.

overlays.name: Campflare Public Lands
overlays.description: Cached Campflare land records where geometry or point locations are available. Use alongside authoritative BLM/PAD-US layers when legal land status matters.

provider_fields.label: Campflare API key
provider_fields.help: Required for Campflare downloads.

overlays.name: Campflare Notices
overlays.description: Cached Campflare campground notices, alerts, closure, weather, and fire-related warnings when included in the Campflare dump.

provider_fields.label: Campflare API key
provider_fields.help: Required for Campflare downloads.

overlays.name: Wildfire Hotspots
overlays.description: NASA FIRMS active fire hotspot snapshot. Refresh before a trip; cached data remains visible offline with age/stale status.
overlays.source_instructions: Create a free NASA FIRMS MAP_KEY and paste it here. OIAB uses the key to refresh active fire hotspots, then keeps the latest successful GeoJSON snapshot for offline display.

provider_fields.label: NASA FIRMS MAP_KEY
provider_fields.help: Required for live NASA FIRMS active fire refreshes. Cached GeoJSON still renders offline.

overlays.warning: Active fire data is informational and may be delayed, incomplete, or wrong.

overlays.name: NWS Weather Alerts
overlays.description: Cached active National Weather Service alert polygons. Refresh requires internet; cached data renders offline with age/stale status.

overlays.name: Snow Depth
overlays.description: Online NOAA NOHRSC snow analysis raster overlay. Designed for winter trip planning; offline regional caching can be added through the bbox cache workflow later.

overlays.name: Drought Monitor
overlays.description: Cached U.S. Drought Monitor polygons. Refresh from a configured GeoJSON source or place generated GeoJSON under the drought overlay directory.
overlays.source_instructions: OIAB defaults to the official current U.S. Drought Monitor GeoJSON feed. Leave this blank to use the built-in feed, or paste a different USDM GeoJSON snapshot if needed.

provider_fields.label: Drought GeoJSON URL
provider_fields.placeholder: Direct U.S. Drought Monitor GeoJSON URL
provider_fields.help: Optional. Leave blank to use the official current USDM GeoJSON. OIAB caches the latest successful copy for offline use.

overlays.name: USGS Stream Gauges
overlays.description: Cached USGS NWIS stream gauge points for a selected bbox. Refresh before a trip to inspect flow and station metadata offline.

overlays.name: Wind Forecast
overlays.description: Placeholder for NOAA/NWS wind forecast raster/vector visualization. Requires a configured service before it can be enabled.
overlays.source_instructions: NOAA/NWS forecast data is time-enabled. This overlay accepts a compatible WMS/XYZ tile template, but the preferred production path is an OIAB adapter like Temperature Forecast so time/product selection is handled safely.

provider_fields.label: Wind tile URL
provider_fields.help: Advanced. Set a compatible WMS/XYZ tile template before enabling this forecast overlay.

overlays.name: Smoke Forecast
overlays.description: Placeholder for NOAA HRRR/RAP smoke forecast visualization. Requires a configured raster/vector source before it can be enabled.
overlays.source_instructions: NOAA smoke products are service/layer/time dependent. This field is for an advanced compatible raster tile template. OIAB should eventually provide a dedicated smoke adapter rather than relying on manual templates.

provider_fields.label: Smoke tile URL
provider_fields.help: Advanced. Set a compatible NOAA/HRRR/RAP smoke raster source before enabling.

overlays.name: NOAA Radar
overlays.description: Online NOAA nowCOAST weather radar base reflectivity mosaic. Live radar only; offline caching will come later via bbox-based area downloads.
overlays.warning: NOAA Radar uses the nowCOAST live base reflectivity mosaic and requires internet. It is a weather radar reflectivity view, not precipitation totals or forecast guidance.

overlays.name: Temperature Forecast
overlays.description: Online NOAA/NWS NDFD temperature forecast raster overlay with point forecast details from api.weather.gov. Cached point forecasts remain visible offline with an age warning.
overlays.warning: Temperature Forecast requires internet for live map tiles. Point forecast lookups are cached for limited offline review.

overlays.name: Dark Sky
overlays.description: Offline raster or vector dark-sky overlay generated from a configured light-pollution raster source. Build once for trip planning, then use offline.
overlays.source_instructions: Dark-sky/light-pollution datasets have licensing and provider differences. Paste a GDAL-readable raster source you are allowed to use; OIAB will generate local offline tiles.

provider_fields.label: Dark-sky source URL
provider_fields.placeholder: Raster source URL or local file URL
provider_fields.help: Use a light-pollution raster source that GDAL can read. OIAB builds local tiles from it.

overlays.name: NASA GIBS Satellite
overlays.description: Online NASA GIBS daily satellite imagery placeholder. A configured WMTS tile template is required before enabling.
overlays.source_instructions: NASA GIBS uses WMTS templates with product, date, projection, and tile matrix set. This manual field is for an advanced fixed product/date template; a future adapter should expose product/date selectors.

provider_fields.label: NASA GIBS tile URL
provider_fields.help: Advanced. Set a NASA GIBS-compatible tile template for the desired product/date/projection.

overlays.name: Recent Lightning
overlays.description: Cached recent lightning strike overlay. Requires a configured provider URL; no default public source is bundled.
overlays.source_instructions: There is no bundled free national lightning-strike feed. If you subscribe to or maintain a provider GeoJSON endpoint, paste it here and OIAB will cache the latest successful snapshot.

provider_fields.label: Lightning GeoJSON URL
provider_fields.help: Set a provider URL for recent lightning points. OIAB caches the latest successful snapshot.

overlays.name: FCC Connectivity
overlays.description: Future connectivity/coverage overlay. Provider datasets vary and are intentionally not enabled until a source is configured.
overlays.source_instructions: FCC connectivity datasets are download/package oriented. Paste a direct vector package URL only if you have selected a specific FCC or provider export; OIAB will convert it to PMTiles.

provider_fields.label: Connectivity source URL
provider_fields.help: Paste a direct vector package URL before generating the connectivity PMTiles overlay.

overlays.name: Parcel Import
overlays.description: Provider hook for future county/state parcel imports. OIAB does not ship parcel data; users can import provider-specific PMTiles later.
overlays.warning: Parcel datasets are provider-specific and may have legal/license restrictions.

overlays.name: Local GeoJSON Overlay
overlays.description: Drop custom.geojson into /data/oiab/maps/overlays and rescan to use this offline vector overlay.

overlays.name: Local PMTiles Vector Overlay
overlays.description: Drop custom-overlay.pmtiles into /data/oiab/maps/overlays and configure its source layer before enabling.
